#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent Python copy of the swing law (Impact.reach_of / inertia / full / energy) for the spec C5 table.
No Godot, no ToolSpec: head volume = steel mass / 7850 x bulk, mass = rho x V, haft mass = rho_haft x V_haft (stock haft
mass at 800 kg/m3). Physique fit: work 150 J, omega 10 rad/s, two hands. Prints the table the craft_calc_test compares to."""
STEEL = 7850.0
# (head steel mass kg, arm m, stock haft mass kg at 800 kg/m3, haft length)
ROWS = {"hatchet": (0.6, 0.35, 0.3), "axe": (1.0, 0.55, 0.4), "two": (1.8, 0.9, 0.6), "maul": (3.2, 0.9, 0.8),
        "pick": (2.2, 0.9, 0.7), "sledge": (4.5, 0.9, 0.6)}
RHO = {"steel": 7850.0, "granite": 2700.0, "flint": 2600.0, "pine": 700.0, "oak": 1050.0, "aspen": 800.0, "ash": 800.0}
BULK = {"steel": 1.0, "granite": 2.0, "flint": 2.0, "pine": 2.0}

def energy(row, head, haft, work=150.0, omega=10.0):
    m_steel, arm, hm_stock = ROWS[row]
    m_head = m_steel / STEEL * RHO[head] * BULK[head]
    m_haft = hm_stock / 800.0 * RHO[haft]
    l = 0.45 + 0.9 * arm
    inertia = m_head * l * l + m_haft * (arm * arm / 3.0 + 0.3 * l * l)
    w = omega
    e = min(work, 0.5 * inertia * w * w)
    return m_head, m_haft, inertia, e

CASES = [("axe", "steel", "aspen"), ("axe", "granite", "aspen"), ("axe", "granite", "oak"), ("axe", "flint", "pine"),
         ("axe", "pine", "aspen"), ("two", "steel", "aspen"), ("two", "granite", "aspen"), ("pick", "steel", "aspen"),
         ("pick", "granite", "aspen"), ("sledge", "steel", "aspen"), ("sledge", "granite", "aspen"), ("sledge", "pine", "aspen")]
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for row, head, haft in CASES:
        mh, mw, i, e = energy(row, head, haft)
        print("%s|%s|%s|%.4f|%.4f|%.4f|%.3f" % (row, head, haft, mh, mw, i, e))
EOF

# Every stock tool = its preset: the volume of the head x steel density is the row's mass; a stone head (x bulk) the stone one.
func _presets() -> void:
	var worst := 0.0
	for slot in CRAFTABLE:
		var row: Dictionary = Tools.LIST[slot]
		var g: Dictionary = HM.preset(slot)
		var m: float = HM.volume(g) * Tools.STEEL_DENSITY
		worst = maxf(worst, absf(m / float(row.mass) - 1.0))
		ok("M2 preset %s mass" % row.short, near(m, float(row.mass), 2e-3) and not g.clamped,
			"V=%.1f cm3 mass=%.4f kg (row %.3f) x=%.3f y=%.3f z=%.4f th=%.0f" % [HM.volume(g) * 1e6, m, row.mass, g.x, g.y, g.z, g.theta])
		for mi in Tools.MATERIALS.size():
			var tool := Tools.make(slot, mi)
			var gt: Dictionary = HM.geom_of_tool(tool)
			var rho: float = Tools.MATERIALS[mi].density
			var mt: float = HM.volume(gt) * rho
			if not near(mt, float(tool.mass), 5e-3) or gt.clamped:

	var sh: Dictionary = HM.geom("scoop", 0.22, 0.27, 0.003, 45.0)

extends Node
## Autotest `autotest=bench` (task 66 part bench-ui), started by the Workbench of the map. Modes (user arg `bench=<mode>`):
##   world   the object: placed near the spawn, collider meta, 2 draw surfaces, outward normals, a ray from the eye finds it
##   layout  the screen's rects at 1152x648 and 1920x1080 (inside the panel, no overlap, text widths, min 13 px)
##   use     E / Tab / Esc / X close, free mouse, panel_open, make + dismantle through the buttons' own functions
##   perf    per-frame cost closed = 0, open = script ms
##   shots   BENCH_SHOT_* markers for the browser
## Prints `BENCH_CHECK <name> ok|FAIL <info>` and `AUTOTEST_DONE ok=<bool>` (web: with the AUTOTEST_ prefix).

var _ok := true
var _mode := "world"
var _me: Actor
var _bench: Workbench


func _ready() -> void:
	Engine.set_meta("autotest", true)
	var args := " ".join(OS.get_cmdline_user_args())
	if OS.has_feature("web"):
		args = str(JavaScriptBridge.eval("location.search"))
	for part in args.replace("&", " ").split(" "):
		if part.begins_with("bench="):
			_mode = part.substr(6)
	_run()


func _say(line: String) -> void:
	print(("AUTOTEST_" if OS.has_feature("web") else "") + line)


func _check(what: String, cond: bool, info := "") -> void:
	_say("BENCH_CHECK %s %s %s" % [what, "ok" if cond else "FAIL", info])
	_ok = _ok and cond


func _ticks(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await get_tree().physics_frame


func _done() -> void:
	_say("AUTOTEST_DONE ok=%s" % str(_ok))
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.3).timeout
	get_tree().quit(0 if _ok else 1)


func _run() -> void:
	for t in 3600:
		await _ticks(1)
		for a in get_tree().current_scene.get_node("Actors").get_children():
			if a is Actor and a.is_local():
				_me = a
		_bench = get_parent() as Workbench
		if _me and get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("held_axe") and t > 90:
			break
	if _me == null or _bench == null:
		_check("setup", false, "actor %s bench %s" % [str(_me), str(_bench)])
		_done()
		return
	match _mode:
		"world":
			await _world()
		_:
			_check("mode", false, _mode)
	_done()


# --- world: the object -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _world() -> void:
	var b := _bench
	var sp := _me.global_position
	var d := Vector2(b.global_position.x - sp.x, b.global_position.z - sp.z).length()
	_say("BENCH world at %s spawn %s dist %.2f" % [str(b.global_position), str(sp), d])
	_check("near the spawn", d > 2.0 and d < 9.0, "%.2f m" % d)
	var body := b.get_node_or_null("Body") as StaticBody3D
	_check("collider with meta workbench", body != null and body.has_meta("workbench") and body.collision_layer == 1)
	var mi := b.get_node_or_null("Model") as MeshInstance3D
	_check("one mesh, 2 surfaces (draws <= 3)", mi != null and mi.mesh.get_surface_count() == 2 and b.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false).size() == 1)
	var verts := 0
	for s in mi.mesh.get_surface_count():
		verts += (mi.mesh.surface_get_arrays(s)[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size()
	_check("light mesh", verts > 100 and verts < 2500, "%d verts" % verts)
	# every triangle's generated normal points out of its box: the top face of the top plank is +Y
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	Workbench._box(st, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(1, 1, 1), Color.WHITE)
	st.generate_normals()
	var arr := st.commit().surface_get_arrays(0)
	var vv: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
	var nn: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL]
	var out := true
	for i in vv.size() / 3:
		var c := (vv[i * 3] + vv[i * 3 + 1] + vv[i * 3 + 2]) / 3.0
		out = out and nn[i * 3].dot(c) > 0.3
	_check("box normals point outward", out)
	# a ray from a point in front of the bench, looking at it, hits the collider
	var front := b.global_transform * Vector3(0.0, 1.2, 1.6)
	var to := b.global_transform * Vector3(0.0, 0.9, 0.0)
	var q := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(front, to)
	var hit := b.get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(q)
	var c := hit.get("collider") as Node
	_check("ray finds the bench body", c != null and c.has_meta("workbench"), str(c))
	_check("near_point reach", Workbench.near_point(get_tree(), front) and not Workbench.near_point(get_tree(), front + Vector3(0, 0, 40)))
EOF

class_name CraftWidgets
extends RefCounted
## The pieces of the bench screen that do not know the game: the layout (a pure function of the screen size, so a
## test checks every rectangle without drawing) and the drawing helpers of concept G in our version: a pocket with
## a thumbnail and two lines of text, a tab, a slider with its number, a card with a volume bar, a result row with a
## balance beam, the big amber button. Everything is drawn on any CanvasItem in screen pixels; the look comes from
## LeatherKit (textures when the art is in, flat boxes otherwise).

const DESIGN := Vector2(1104.0, 600.0)      # the panel in design px at u = 1 (1152 x 648 minus a 24 px margin)
const FONT := 13                             # the smallest text, design px (x u on a big screen)
const MARGIN := 24.0
const TABS := 7
const SLIDERS := 5
const POCKET_COLS := 2
const TOOL_COLS := 6

## One unit: 1.0 on the 1152 x 648 canvas, up to 1.7 on a big screen (fonts and rects grow together).
static func unit(size: Vector2) -> float:
	return clampf(minf((size.x - MARGIN) / DESIGN.x, (size.y - MARGIN) / DESIGN.y), 1.0, 1.7)


## Every rectangle of the screen, in screen px, for a viewport of `size`.
static func layout(size: Vector2) -> Dictionary:
	var u := unit(size)
	var ps := DESIGN * u
	var o := ((size - ps) * 0.5).floor()
	var R := func(x: float, y: float, w: float, h: float) -> Rect2:
		return Rect2(o + Vector2(x, y) * u, Vector2(w, h) * u)
	var L := {}
	L.u = u
	L.panel = Rect2(o, ps)
	L.header = R.call(0, 0, 1104, 46)
	L.title = R.call(0, 0, 1104, 46)
	L.close = R.call(1104 - 44, 7, 32, 32)
	L.pages = R.call(10, 4, 420, 36)               # the page tabs, drawn only when there is more than one page
	L.footer = R.call(0, 572, 1104, 28)
	# left column: the bag
	var lx := 10.0
	var lw := 298.0
	L.left = R.call(lx, 52, lw, 516)
	L.left_title = R.call(lx + 10, 56, lw - 20, 28)
	L.pockets = R.call(lx + 8, 88, lw - 16, 274)   # 3 rows of 2 big pockets, scrolls
	L.tools_title = R.call(lx + 10, 368, lw - 20, 22)
	L.tools = R.call(lx + 8, 392, lw - 16, 96)     # 2 rows of 6 tool pockets
	L.hands = R.call(lx + 8, 492, lw - 16, 44)     # two hand pockets
	L.note = R.call(lx + 10, 540, lw - 20, 22)
	# centre: the constructor
	var cx := 318.0
	var cw := 490.0
	L.centre = R.call(cx, 52, cw, 516)
	L.centre_title = R.call(cx + 10, 56, cw - 20, 28)
	L.tabs = R.call(cx + 8, 88, cw - 16, 76)
	L.preset = R.call(cx + 8, 168, cw - 16, 28)    # the shovel sizes, else the shape's line
	L.preview = R.call(cx + 8, 200, cw - 16, 200)
	L.sliders = R.call(cx + 8, 406, cw - 16, 84)
	L.strip = R.call(cx + 8, 494, cw - 16, 68)
	# right: the result

	var rw := 276.0
	L.right = R.call(rx, 52, rw, 516)
	L.head_card = R.call(rx + 8, 58, rw - 16, 92)
	L.haft_card = R.call(rx + 8, 154, rw - 16, 92)
	L.rows = R.call(rx + 8, 252, rw - 16, 150)
	L.works = R.call(rx + 8, 406, rw - 16, 26)
	L.short = R.call(rx + 8, 436, rw - 16, 24)
	L.make = R.call(rx + 8, 464, rw - 16, 50)

## The i-th big pocket of the bag column (row-major, scrolled by `scroll` rows), as a rect.
static func pocket_rect(L: Dictionary, i: int, scroll := 0) -> Rect2:
	var u: float = L.u
	var a: Rect2 = L.pockets
	var gap := 8.0 * u
	var w := (a.size.x - gap) / POCKET_COLS
	var h := (a.size.y - 2.0 * gap) / 3.0
	var row := i / POCKET_COLS - scroll
	return Rect2(a.position + Vector2((i % POCKET_COLS) * (w + gap), row * (h + gap)), Vector2(w, h))

static func tool_rect(L: Dictionary, i: int) -> Rect2:
	var u: float = L.u

	var gap := 6.0 * u
	var w := (a.size.x - gap * (TOOL_COLS - 1)) / TOOL_COLS
	var h := (a.size.y - gap) / 2.0
	return Rect2(a.position + Vector2((i % TOOL_COLS) * (w + gap), (i / TOOL_COLS) * (h + gap)), Vector2(w, h))

	var a: Rect2 = L.hands
	var gap := 8.0 * u
